competences.description: Attacks the enemy with a sword and increases the enemy's skill cooldown time by 1 turn each with a 20% chance. [Seal of Light] is automatically activated if the enemy dies.

effets.description: Reduces cool down counter of skills by 1 or more
Attacks an additional time on the same turn.
effets.note: When enemy dies from this attack, applies to Soul Reaper

effets.description: Puts the target's skill on cool down.

competences.description: Attacks the enemy to increase its chances of landing a Glancing Hit and Silence the enemy for 2 turns each. The enemy under the Silence Effect won't be able to use skills with cooldown time excluding the passive skills. The damage is proportionate to the enemy's MAX HP.

effets.description: Skills with cooldowns will be locked. (Passive skills not included)

The chance of landing a glancing hit will be increased by 50%. Glancing Hits will decrease the damage by 30% and if the attacker has attribute disadvantage, damage will be decreased additionally by 16%.

competences.description: Calls upon the power of the divine shield, gaining immunity against all effects. Additionally, the chance of allies receiving a Critical Hit is reduced by 15%. Increases your Attack Bar by 5%, up to 20%, every time an ally is hit by a non-Critical Hit. The effect is not accumulated with other Critical Hit reduction effects. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: The target will gain immunity against all harmful effects.
Critical Hit Rate against the monster is reduced by 50%
The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
effets.note: every time an ally is hit by a non-critical attack
